page_title: FUL 0-0 SOU | Fulham v Southampton 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Tim Robinson has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' A cross from a corner kick by Southampton is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+4' A corner kick by Southampton is thwarted by the well prepared Bernd Leno (Fulham).
90+4' The resulting set piece from Southampton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Southampton earn a corner.
90+1' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Adam Armstrong comes off the pitch to be replaced by Paul Onuachu (Southampton).
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball. The ball is out of play. Fulham win a corner kick.
89' Fulham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
88' Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Aaron Ramsdale stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
87' Substitution. Harry Wilson walks off the pitch and Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) comes on as a substitute.
86' That was close. Adama Traore (Fulham) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
84' Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) is cautioned by the referee after being shown a yellow card for dissent.
84' Flynn Downes (Southampton) commits a rough foul. Tim Robinson stops the game and makes a call.
83' The ball possession at the moment is 57:43. The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:5. 4:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
82' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Aaron Ramsdale was alert and made a comfortable save.
81' The free kick is taken by Mateus Fernandes (Southampton), but ball is cleared.
80' Substitution. Yukinari Sugawara leaves the pitch and is replaced by James Bree (Southampton).
79' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
79' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and signals a foul after Raul Jimenez (Fulham) brought his opponent down. That's a free kick to Southampton.

78' Martial Godo (Fulham) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
76' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Martial Godo (Fulham) replacing Tom Cairney.
76' Marco Silva is forced to make a change. Sander Berge (Fulham) is unable to continue due to injury, Sasa Lukic comes on.
75' The foul by Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) was seen by Tim Robinson who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Fulham have a free kick.
75' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
73' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
70' Sander Berge (Fulham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

68' Harry Wilson (Fulham) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the left post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
67' The resulting corner from Harry Wilson (Fulham) is cleared by the defence.

66' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. It will be a corner kick for Fulham.

65' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The referee points to the corner flag and Fulham will take a corner.

63' What a save from Aaron Ramsdale! Alex Iwobi (Fulham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
62' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Joshua King will be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
62' It is time for a substitution. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is on for Rodrigo Muniz.
62' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
62' The ball is out of play and Southampton manage to earn a corner.

61' An attempted cross from Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) is cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Southampton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

58' Cameron Archer (Southampton) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
58' A player from Fulham commits a rough challenge. Tim Robinson blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Southampton have a free kick.
57' Simon Rusk has decided to make a change. Lesley Ugochukwu (Southampton) replaces Joe Aribo.
56' The keeper makes a simple save after Adam Armstrong (Southampton) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
54' Tim Robinson blows his whistle. Jan Bednarek (Southampton) commits a foul after dangerous play. Fulham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
54' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but Aaron Ramsdale punches the ball away.
50' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
49' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
48' Yellow card. Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
48' Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) is penalised for holding. Tim Robinson signals a set piece. Fulham are awarded the free kick.

46' Joshua King (Fulham) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
46' Simon Rusk has made a change at the break. Cameron Archer (Southampton) has come on in place of Tyler Dibling.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The game is interrupted as Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) is flagged offside.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Nathan Wood (Southampton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
38' The move breaks down when Alex Iwobi (Fulham) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
38' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
34' Flynn Downes (Southampton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tim Robinson had an easy-decision to make.
34' Flynn Downes (Southampton) jumps into a tackle and Tim Robinson signals a foul. It's a free kick to Fulham, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
33' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
31' The percentage of ball possession is – 59:41. We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:1. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.

28' Harry Wilson (Fulham) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
26' Harry Wilson (Fulham) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
23' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Harry Wilson (Fulham), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
19' A snap shot by Alex Iwobi (Fulham) from distance flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.
16' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
16' Harry Wilson (Fulham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
14' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Antonee Robinson (Fulham) heads on.
11' Joshua King (Fulham) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
8' Harry Wilson (Fulham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
7' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Tyler Dibling (Southampton). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

6' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee signals a corner kick to Southampton.
4' Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

4' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) receives a cross on the edge of the box. He doesn't hesitate and fires a bullet towards the goal. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper had no trouble dealing with his shot. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
